A THOUGHTFUL LITTLE MATCH

Break own road temporarily to distribute buried stones, cap rival road, choose wall defense versus scoring flat, or use capstone to reopen blocked corridor. Drop partition changes several owners in one turn.

Take a seat
How to play
5×5 board; each side 15 flat/wall stones and one capstone. On turn place reserve flat or standing wall onto empty cell, or move a stack controlled by own top. Carry up to five top stones in original vertical order along one orthogonal ray, dropping at least one at each visited cell; must drop all carried stones. Cannot cross/land on wall or capstone, except lone final capstone can flatten standing wall. Flat tops and capstone tops connect own road between opposite edges; standing walls do not connect. Opening two turns place one rival flat on empty cell.
Connect either opposite edge pair by own orthogonal flat/capstone tops wins; simultaneous roads favor mover. Full board or empty reserve without road: more top flats wins, equal draw.
